tools.name: drone_check
tools.description: Use when someone asks whether or how they can fly a drone in Thailand, e.g. "can I fly my drone in Phuket", "do I need to register my DJI Mini in Thailand", "drone rules Bangkok", "Drohne Thailand Registrierung", "darf ich in Thailand mit der Drohne fliegen", "Drohne mitnehmen Thailand", "drone Thaï

tools.name: how_droneclear_helps
